method.ability_resolution: current preprocessed gSpeciesInfo via verify_trainer_ability_legality helpers; exact authored ability only, never species potential
method.move_evidence: current preprocessed moves_info category/effect plus named native interaction candidates
limits: Static inventory only: not tactical sign-off, native execution proof, or completed-battle review.
Party coexistence and legal moves do not prove simultaneous field position, target choice, survival, switch timing, or AI selection.
compiled_tactic_route means an authored tactic is materialized for planner consideration, not a forced or observed execution.
Conflict and synergy candidates are flags for individual review, not bugs or quality verdicts.
Counts describe exact authored base-party Ability requests, not executed or fully supported strategies; static evidence is classified separately.
Mega Evolution and other form changes can replace a base-party Ability during battle; this inventory does not project post-transformation Abilities.
read_teams enumerates authored trainer branches, but conditional regional-rival runtime overrides outside this catalog require live encounter review.
